fields.text: UTF-8 provider input after canonical normalization
fields.language: explicit BCP-47 locale or language code
fields.model_constraints: registry identity, revision, license and capability constraints; never an arbitrary path
fields.consent_proof: VoiceConsentProof when a human voice reference or identity is used
fields.reference_transcript: text plus digest for transcript-dependent cloning
fields.experimental_language_ack: explicit acknowledgement; never creates production eligibility

rules: status MUST equal GRANTED at admission and execution time
scope MUST include VOICE_SYNTHESIS and VOICE_CLONING when applicable
purpose MUST cover the requested output use
subject_authorized MUST be true
provenance_ref, issuer_ref, jurisdiction, legal_basis_ref, signature_ref and revocation_ref MUST be non-empty
derived voice assets MUST bind derived_asset_lineage_ref and retention_policy_ref
revocation or expiry MUST produce an auditable deletion receipt before retained derived assets may be considered closed
expired or revoked consent MUST fail closed
provider MUST NOT mint, infer, extend or persist consent
scope MUST include VOICE_CONVERSION for human-target voice conversion when applicable
scope MUST include SINGING_VOICE_CONVERSION for human-target singing conversion when applicable
scope MUST cover REALTIME_VOICE_CONVERSION when a live human-target transformation is requested
audio_sha256 MUST match bytes consumed by provider
transcript digest MUST match bytes/text consumed when a transcript is used
voice identity MUST remain stable across request, decision, result and evidence
reference retention and deletion MUST follow the authorized policy
no silent provider, model, device, cloud or language fallback
hu-HU cloning MUST select an admitted Hungarian cloning provider
unsupported or unverified language routes MUST fail closed
research-only or non-commercial providers MUST NOT serve production requests
open-source code classification MUST NOT be inherited by model or voice artifacts
unknown, incompatible or purpose-restricted rights MUST fail closed
license acceptance MUST be explicit and auditable when required
result MUST bind request, provider, runtime, model, reference, decision, device and output lineage
native-rate master MUST be preserved when media projection resamples
result MUST carry language promotion eligibility and synthetic-audio disclosure
result MUST NOT promote provider-specific session semantics into canonical authority

fields.source_audio_ref: authorized immutable source audio artifact reference
fields.target_voice_identity_ref: canonical target voice identity; optional only for SPEECH_REPRESENTATION
fields.consent_proof: VoiceConsentProof covering the requested transformation and purpose
fields.pitch_intent: bounded provider-neutral pitch preservation or transformation intent
fields.language: explicit language/locale when linguistic content is relevant
fields.provider_constraints: optional allow/deny and local-only constraints; never direct execution authority
fields.license_and_rights_status: resolved admission status; MUST equal PASS before execution
fields.resource_admission_ref: required for any accelerator execution; issued only by Host Resource Broker
fields.provider_eligibility: selected provider MUST be independently admitted; reference-only providers are forbidden

rules: no provider, model, device, cloud or language fallback may occur silently
target human voice identity requires valid purpose-scoped non-expired non-revoked consent
provider selection remains exclusive to FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001
device placement and accelerator leases remain exclusive to FA3-AUTH-HOST-RESOURCE-BROKER-001
unknown or incompatible rights fail closed
reference-only donor children cannot be selected as providers
result MUST bind request, source audio, target voice identity when applicable, provider, model, device and output lineage
native-rate master MUST be preserved when media projection resamples
synthetic or transformed-audio disclosure MUST be retained
result MUST NOT create provider-specific consent, identity, routing or hardware authority
REALTIME_VOICE_CONVERSION requires an explicit latency budget
session start requires valid consent, rights and Host Resource Broker admission
dropout, jitter and latency observations MUST be auditable
session termination MUST release resource leases and produce a session receipt
representation artifacts are derived assets, not identity or routing authorities
speaker/content disentanglement claims require evidence and MUST NOT be inferred from provider marketing
reuse across providers requires compatible rights and canonical provenance
